about: API-3 scope (API-STANDARD S33-S36). Curated by cb-api with the owning area. money_writes: routes that move or record money; each must require an Idempotency-Key. inbound: routes that take a peer's or a webhook's JSON; each must schema-check it before use. money_reviewed_not: routes whose path looks like money but that write nothing (a preview, a build). public_ids: routes whose path value S35 does not apply to, each with its reason: public by design (a public door, a counterparty door, platform reference), or a label or reference that names nothing outside the caller's own shop (a fiscal year, a per-shop reference); foreign_id_404 (S35) does not apply to them. tools/api-register.cjs --check fails when a mutating route that looks like money is in none of the lists.

public_ids.GET /api/catalogue/:bridge_id: public door: the storefront addresses a shop by its published bridge_id; any visitor may, signed in or not
public_ids.GET /api/catalogue/:bridge_id/capture-fi: public door: the storefront addresses a shop by its published bridge_id; any visitor may, signed in or not
public_ids.POST /api/catalogue/:bridge_id/order/sta: public door: the storefront addresses a shop by its published bridge_id; any visitor may, signed in or not
public_ids.POST /api/catalogue/:bridge_id/support/s: public door: the storefront addresses a shop by its published bridge_id; any visitor may, signed in or not
public_ids.GET /api/catalogue/network-store/:networ: public door: a network store is published for every member and visitor
public_ids.POST /api/catalogue/enquiry/:item_id: counterparty door: an enquiry is a business asking about ANOTHER business's published item, which rings that owner's bell (sec4 C); another shop's item id answering is the purpose (API-24, 2026-11-01)
public_ids.GET /api/governance/boilerplate/:key: platform reference: a boilerplate is the platform's, offered to every shop, not one shop's
public_ids.POST /api/governance/boilerplate/:key/ad: platform reference: the key names the platform's boilerplate; the adoption is written to the caller's own shop
public_ids.GET /api/governance/source/:key: platform reference: a catalogue source is shared by every shop it serves
public_ids.GET /api/governance/readiness/:bridge_id: counterparty door: the readiness passport is built for outsiders (Athi 2026-08-20); a stranger gets status and rung only, evidence_ref stripped (SEC-FIX3 S6)
public_ids.GET /api/assist/container/:id: platform reference: a container is shared catalogue reference that chits pin by version
public_ids.POST /api/integrations/ask/:handle/stock: public door: a shop's published handle answers stock to an asking peer
public_ids.GET /api/integrations/stock/:handle: public door: a shop's published handle answers stock to an asking peer
public_ids.PUT /api/folders/inventory/:code: platform reference: the code names a system folder of the platform's inventory (lib/folder-inventory: B-2100, RT-4090 …), the same in every shop; the switch is written to the caller's own policy
public_ids.GET /api/books/year/:fy/status: label: a fiscal-year label, the same in every shop; read only inside the caller's own periods (WHERE entity_id = $1), no path from the label to a row id (lib/books-store periods)
public_ids.POST /api/books/year/:fy/close: label: a fiscal-year label, the same in every shop; it acts only on the caller's own periods (setPeriodStatus names entity_id = $1)
public_ids.POST /api/books/periods/:fy/:p/:act: label: a fiscal-year label, a period number and an action word, the same in every shop; the UPDATE names the caller's entity (lib/books-store setPeriodStatus)
public_ids.POST /api/books/loans/:ref/emi: per-shop reference: loan:<ref> is the entry's source_ref, typed by the owner and unique inside one shop; looked up only with entity_id = $1, refused before any write when absent
public_ids.POST /api/books/accruals/:ref/reverse: per-shop reference: accrual:<ref> is the entry's source_ref, typed by the owner and unique inside one shop; looked up only with entity_id = $1, refused before any write when absent
